summary: CSP lacks connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost, so release builds fall back from the fast IPC path to postMessage on every launch
evidence: tauri.conf.json:24 csp without connect-src; tauri core.js:16-17 builds http://ipc.localhost URL; ipc-protocol.js:37-67 fetch blocked then fallback; tauri-utils config.rs:2895,2910 reference config includes connect-src ipc:
failure_scenario: First invoke in a release build logs a CSP violation; all later IPC uses postMessage. Commands still work but CSP noise hides real violations.
